items.rationale: The bicycle and its frame are excluded means of transport under 4.3(b); 7.1.8(a) excludes the replacement cost.
Clause 4.3(b) expressly excludes bicycle braking assemblies, and 7.1.8(a) excludes their replacement.
Carriage for the excluded bicycle is not indemnifiable under 4.3(b) and 7.1.8(a).
The workshop attended solely for the excluded bicycle, so its vehicle charge is excluded under 7.1.8(a) and (f).
Clause 7.1.8(a) excludes assembly work on the bicycle, which is uninsured under 4.3(b).
Under 7.1.8(a) and 7.1.10, sundries follow the work they serve; these were used on the excluded bicycle.
Clauses 7.1.8(a) and 7.1.10 exclude the one apprentice hour because it was spent on the uninsured bicycle.
Clauses 7.1.8(a) and 7.1.10 exclude all three skilled hours because they were spent on the uninsured bicycle.
Clause 7.1.7(g) covers one attendance by the locksmith for the insured forced-entry repair. Allow €65 gross for the single visit; no deductible amount is stated.

Clauses 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(d) cover fitting and testing a like-for-like lock. Allow €75 gross for distinct fitting work, without duplicating the hourly labour under 7.1.8(g) or funding an upgrade under 7.1.9.
Clause 7.1.7(f) covers fixings and consumables incorporated into the damaged door repair. Allow €20 gross for one ordinary sundries charge.
Clauses 7.1.7(e) and 11.3 expressly cover apprentice labour on the affected building. Allow one hour at €45 gross.
Clauses 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(e) cover skilled labour to restore the forced back-door locking point. Allow one hour at €95 gross.
